title: Decision: SSE frame size cap (1 MiB) checked on both raw_buf and decoded buf
description: subscribe_events caps both raw_buf and buf at SSE_BUF_SIZE_LIMIT (1 MiB). A future contributor might ask why both. The raw_buf cap prevents OOM from a server that streams indefinitely-invalid UTF-8 (decode_utf8_chunk makes progress on valid input, but a server sending only invalid bytes would never drain raw_buf without the cap). The buf cap prevents OOM from a server that sends a single enormous valid-UTF-8 frame. Both caps are necessary for different attack surfaces. The SSE frame too large error correctly terminates the stream state machine (returns None as next state).
